WITH
  date_filter AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
  ),
  cd_filter AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_dep_count
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'F'
      AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
  ),
  cust_filter AS (
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk, c_current_cdemo_sk, c_birth_year
    FROM customer
    WHERE c_birth_month IN (1,3,7,11,10,4)
  ),
  addr_filter AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state IN ('AL','MO','TN','GA','MT','IN','CA')
  )
SELECT
  i.i_item_id,
  ca.ca_country,
  ca.ca_state,
  ca.ca_county,
  avg(cast(cs.cs_quantity AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg1,
  avg(cast(cs.cs_list_price AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg2,
  avg(cast(cs.cs_coupon_amt AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg3,
  avg(cast(cs.cs_sales_price AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg4,
  avg(cast(cs.cs_net_profit AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg5,
  avg(cast(c.c_birth_year AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg6,
  avg(cast(cd1.cd_dep_count AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg7
FROM catalog_sales AS cs
JOIN date_filter AS d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN item AS i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN cd_filter AS cd1 ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
JOIN cust_filter AS c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics AS cd2 ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
JOIN addr_filter AS ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
  (i.i_item_id, ca.ca_country, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_county),
  (i.i_item_id, ca.ca_country, ca.ca_state),
  (i.i_item_id, ca.ca_country),
  (i.i_item_id),
  ()
)
ORDER BY ca.ca_country, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_county, i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
